title: Diverse rare ginsenosides derived from ginsenoside Re in aqueous methanol solution via heterogeneous catalysis and identified by HPLC-MS
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16455-16467
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02261D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanyan Chang, Bing Li, Yusheng Xiao, Mengya Zhao, Yujiang Zhou, Huanxi Zhao, Yang Xiu
Using a composite heterogeneous catalyst, HSiW@MeSi, in an aqueous methanol solution, ginsenoside Re was chemically transformed into 30 rare ginsenosides, which were then identified by HPLC-MSn.
